purpose: Replace the over-resolved B16 curve and narrow conditional refit envelope with a monotone visual guide plus a conservative finite-grid directional transition region.
epistemic_role: Exploratory presentation of decoder-specific finite-window trend evidence; not a threshold, thermodynamic boundary, or publication-strength contour confidence set.

evidence_model.cell_likelihood: Independent binomial logical-error counts by measured distance with Jeffreys Beta(1/2,1/2) posteriors.
evidence_model.directional_quantity: Posterior probability that the finite-window OLS projection slope of latent LER against measured distance is upward versus downward.

transition_region.measured_rows: Use all sixteen non-null B11 lower directional brackets through q=0.75.
transition_region.right_censor_rule: At each row, lower support is the largest sampled p with Pr(upward|data)<=0.1 before the unsampled p=0.5 edge; upper support is p=0.5. Stop at the first q row whose p=0.49 cell is confidently downward.
transition_region.monotone_envelope: Use the narrowest nondecreasing lower/upper envelopes that contain every registered finite-grid bracket; do not spline or interpolate sub-grid features.
transition_region.interpretation: Conservative finite-grid directional bracket/censoring region, not a pointwise or simultaneous confidence/credible band for the guide.

guide.start_rule: First q=0 downward-to-upward Pr(upward|data)=0.5 crossing by linear interpolation in p.
guide.end_rule: First high-q positive-to-negative log-odds crossing at p=0.49 by linear interpolation in q, rendered on the p=0.5 plot edge.
guide.interior_control_constraint: start_p <= p1 <= p2 <= 0.5, guaranteeing nondecreasing p(q)
guide.objective: Least-squares distance to B11 bracket midpoints, used only to place the visual guide.

required: guide is nondecreasing in p over q and has no low-q right-then-left reversal
transition region contains every registered B11 bracket and every high-q censoring bracket
transition region is materially wider than the withdrawn B16 conditional refit envelope
figure contains no curve legend or fitting-method footer
source hashes and data-currency checks pass
no decoder run or new decode occurs

display.region: light neutral finite-grid directional bracket/censoring region

stop_rule: Stop after one registered existing-data analysis, validation, figure, report update, and visual audit; do not add new decoder samples or promote an asymptotic boundary claim.
